name: System (medium): modular monolith with identity, outbox and worker
summary: A whole small-company system that runs with one command: a React single-page app and a Spring Boot 4 / Spring Modulith modular monolith behind a Traefik gateway, signing people in through Keycloak (OIDC authorization code, backend-for-frontend cookie session), with PostgreSQL 18, Valkey sessions and rate limits, SeaweedFS S3 attachments, flagd feature flags, a transactional outbox with a separate worker, an audit trail and Mailpit for mail. Tasks with assignment emails are the worked feature. Tests: 104 unit and architecture tests plus integration tests on real PostgreSQL and Valkey, 31 web tests, and a compose smoke that signs in and follows a task through the outbox and the audit log. The middle stage of a small -> medium -> large growth path.
features: Keycloak sign-in through the API (BFF cookie session, CSRF, roles from the realm), machine client for automation
Transactional outbox with a worker, idempotent consumers, audit trail, S3 attachments, feature flags
Hardened compose (no capabilities, read-only filesystems, digest-pinned images), CI with SHA-pinned actions

toolchain.installHint: Install a JDK 25 (Temurin: https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=25) and Node 24+. Docker is required: the system is a set of containers (Keycloak, PostgreSQL, Valkey, SeaweedFS, Traefik).
